summary: IBM's family of compatible mainframes, from small to large, all running the same software. It was a huge bet that paid off: it set the 8-bit byte, ran businesses and the Apollo programme, and today's IBM Z mainframes still run its programs.

events.note: IBM announces the whole System/360 family on one day.

events.label: First ships
events.note: The Model 30 is the first to ship.

events.label: Model 91
events.note: Ships with up to 16.6 million instructions per second.

events.label: System/370
events.note: The compatible System/370 replaces most models.
IBM stops marketing all System/360 models.
IBM Z mainframes still run System/360 programs.

cause: Replaced by its compatible successor, the System/370.
